degasser_operations.label: Pump A — Single pre-mixed, pre-degassed feed containing substrate, Michael acceptor, and photocatalyst in EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v). All components are compatible in the absence of O₂. Pre-degassed offline with argon sparging and stored under argon headspace.
degasser_operations.rationale: Single pre-mixed, pre-degassed feed containing substrate, Michael acceptor, and photocatalyst in EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v). All components are compatible in the absence of O₂. Pre-degassed offline with argon sparging and stored under argon headspace.

deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of EtOH and pH 9 buffer (≥20 min, fine frit) prior to feed preparation; feed solution prepared and stored under argon in sealed reservoir with argon headspace during pumping; no inline degasser (hard constraint)
pre_reactor_steps: Offline argon sparging of EtOH and pH 9 aqueous buffer separately for ≥20 min using a fine frit, then combine 5:1 v/v under argon blanket.
Dissolve PMPSCH2TMS (1a, 0.1 M), acrylonitrile (2a, 0.2 M), and Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)2(dtbpy)PF6 (0.5 mol%) in the pre-degassed EtOH/buffer mixture under argon atmosphere.
Transfer feed solution to sealed feed reservoir (e.g., Schlenk flask or sealed HPLC bottle) with argon headspace. Maintain argon blanket throughout pumping. No inline degasser used (hard constraint).
Purge all Stage 1 FEP tubing and coil with degassed solvent under argon before starting reaction flow.

stage_2_air_streams.pump_role: Air MFC delivering gas oxidant at interstage T-mixer between Stage 1 and Stage 2 coils
stage_2_air_streams.reasoning: Deterministic gas stoichiometry: inlet/STP MFC flow was recomputed from target gas equivalents (1.00 equiv), liquid flow 0.04283 mL/min, and substrate concentration. Pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow is reported separately; supplied gas equiv = 1.00.
